notes: 35 native PLUS observations, 2026-11-20, saved directly to project. Full192×63 body and statuses compared without masks.

The old long scientific-format branch diverged exactly at subtract on row2. PLUS replaces the current x with preceding x minus Step and advances; this also applies to filled nonzero rows, not only zero/blank cells.

Independent short ranges -1..1 and0..2 confirm plus/minus through existing rows. Row1 ignores both keys because it has no preceding x. Cursor stays in its column on advance; f(x) and undefined g(x) selections share the shortcut.
Descending5..1 Step2 stores normalized Step=-2; shortcuts use that signed step. Operators inside a draft remain arithmetic:1+2 commits3.

Exploratory labels that implied an ignored key or first row were renamed to the actual observed step/revisited row. Native pixels,statuses and cumulative key traces preserved. Norm2/Sci3/Fix1 reproduce the original long branch exactly.
